title: v2 intent upgrade blocks on an interactive read with no TTY
body:
v2 `intent upgrade` blocks on an interactive read. A real 2.10.0 -> 2.19.0
migration HUNG and was killed at 2 minutes; the identical run with stdin CLOSED
completed in seconds at rc=0. There is no --yes flag.

WHY THIS IS HIGH RATHER THAN A NUISANCE: 11 of 16 fleet projects are BELOW the
2.19.0 floor and need exactly this upgrade. Anything driving it without a TTY --
a git hook, a script, a scheduled sweep, an agent session -- HANGS SILENTLY
rather than failing. A hang is worse than an error here because nothing reports
it and the caller cannot distinguish it from slow work.

SHIPPED-SURFACE, so under hv's freeze scope this one lands in BOTH trees, unlike
intent#0070 which is v3-only.
